Resolves #21623

Related: #21346 · #21140 · #21613 · #21616

Adds `examples/gantt/workingTime`, a 12-task linked kitchen renovation Gantt chart across a fixed UTC calendar (`2026-11-02` to `2026-11-25`) containing weekends (`Sat 7–Sun 8 Nov`, `Sat 14–Sun 15 Nov`, `Sat 21–Sun 22 Nov`) and one public holiday (`Thu 2026-11-12`), backed by `Neo.gantt.TaskStore` (`TaskStore`), `Neo.gantt.TaskModel` (`TaskModel`), and `Neo.gantt.DependencyStore` (`DependencyStore`), and wires duration-driven calendar-switch rescheduling into `Neo.gantt.Container#rescheduleWorkingTime` (`src/gantt/Container.mjs` + `src/gantt/Cascade.mjs`). Starts with `"Count working days only"` switched on (`useWorkingTime: true`), so the 5-day `"Rough plumbing & gas"` task (`t3`) starting Thursday `2026-11-05` spans `Sat 7–Sun 8 Nov` and finishes at the end of Wednesday `11 Nov` (`2026-11-12T00:00:00Z`, its fifth working day), `"Hood & exterior duct"` (`t5`, `3d`) spans the `Thu 12 Nov` holiday, and `"Drywall & plaster"` (`t6`, `2d`, FS from `t3`) skips both `Thu 12 Nov` and `Sat 14–Sun 15 Nov`.

**Behavior when a task is dropped on a non-working day (AC-3) & across calendar switches:**
- With `"Count working days only"` **on** (`useWorkingTime: true`), `Neo.gantt.Container#moveTask` snaps the dropped `startDate` **forward** (`direction = +1`) via `timeAxis.snapToWorkingTime(startMs, 1)` to `00:00` of the next working day (dropping `t3` on Saturday `2026-11-07` snaps its start to Monday `2026-11-09` and evaluates its 5 working days across `Thu 2026-11-12` and `Sat 14–Sun 15 Nov` to `2026-11-17`, cascading downstream FS successors through `t12` at `2026-11-24..2026-11-25`).
- With `"Count working days only"` **off** (`useWorkingTime: false`), `moveTask` places `startDate` directly on the non-working day (`2026-11-07`) and adds raw calendar duration (`2026-11-12`).
- When `useWorkingTime` flips in either direction, `Neo.gantt.Container#rescheduleWorkingTime` preserves hand-placed positive float (`prevStartMs > prevReqStart`, snapping Saturday forward to Monday when entering working-time mode unless overtaken by an upstream predecessor) while pulling/pushing predecessor-bound tasks (`prevStartMs <= prevReqStart`) and publishing through the container's writer (`taskChange` / `schedule` service).

**Catalog record for #21613:**
- `id`: `'gantt-working-time'`
- `name`: `'Durations in working days'`
- `feature`: `'Tasks that skip weekends and holidays when they compute their end'`
- `lookFor`: `'Switch working days off: every task that crosses a weekend ends earlier, and its successors move up.'`
- `cover`: The plan with a five-day task spanning a shaded weekend (`workingtime-1440x900-dark.jpg`).
